name: EARNZ plc
summary: Established in London, UK, in 2016 and previously known as Verditek PLC until its renaming in March 2024, EARNZ plc functions as a clean technology enterprise. Its operations span the United Kingdom, Italy, and the broader European market. The company is dedicated to the production and market introduction of innovative solar technologies, particularly focusing on lightweight and adaptable solar panels. These versatile solar modules find application across a diverse array of sectors, including transportation, property development, consumer retail, and telecommunications. Moreover, they provide power solutions for leisure vehicles and vacation properties, solar carports and electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and various hospitality endeavors such as hotels, safaris, glamping sites, and corporate events. Their utility also extends to critical uses within military operations, disaster response efforts, and temporary construction facilities.
